content.short: Hummus Exchange is a specialized stablecoin AMM on Metis, offering single-sided liquidity and low-slippage swaps.
content.description:
Hummus Exchange is a leading decentralized exchange on Metis, specifically designed for highly efficient stablecoin swaps. Originally forked from Platypus Finance, the protocol employs a unique AMM model that allows for single-sided liquidity provision. This eliminates the risk of impermanent loss for providers while ensuring ultra-low slippage and high capital efficiency for traders dealing in assets like USDT, USDC, and DAI.

To enhance utility, Hummus has expanded with volatile asset pools and yield-boosting mechanisms. Users can stake the native HUM token to receive veHUM, which increases rewards on their deposited liquidity. By integrating Chainlink price feeds, Hummus provides a secure and scalable environment for Metis users to maximize their yields and execute trades with minimal friction.
